settings.executionWarmupScope: untimed full encoder and explicit-KV decode on the same runtime, encoder context, and decoder context immediately before each measured request; state resets to the blocked P=1 sentinel
settings.runOrderPolicy: deterministic forward/reverse pairs, rotating the first tier by one position after every pair
settings.sampleIsolation: fresh Node process, Chrome process/profile, pinned ONNX Runtime WebGPU runtime, and encoder/decoder sessions; fresh native child process/runtime; fresh Node process, Chrome process/profile, VolvoxAI WebGPU runtime, and encoder/decoder contexts

native-c.synchronization: execute completion for the selected strict backend
native-c.kvHandoff: application vx_result_read and host KV validation/copy occur after the reported execute interval

onnxruntime-web.synchronization: required CPU public outputs materialized by session.run
onnxruntime-web.kvHandoff: public cross/present KV gpu-buffer Tensor objects are reused directly; the measured harness performs zero KV readbacks

volvoxai-webgpu.timer: host wall time from context execute through the required small-output GPU readback
volvoxai-webgpu.synchronization: the small control-output readback waits for prior queued GPU work; execution-phase provider time records host enqueue, not GPU completion
volvoxai-webgpu.kvHandoff: public device tensors are handed directly to the next context execution; cache correctness readback is untimed

childProcessEnvironment.policy: inherit non-Volvox variables, remove every uppercase VOLVOX* runtime override, then force the common CPU thread-limit variables
childProcessEnvironment.scope: all ONNX Runtime, native C, ORT WebGPU, VolvoxAI WebGPU, and dynamic-qualification child processes

settings.commonTimingExclusions: process startup, model load/compile, preprocessing, tokenization, same-context warmup, and application correctness validation

onnxRuntime.comparisonLabel: optimized-session WebGPU/CPU partition counts; strict probe rejected

threads.scope: ONNX Runtime Web WASM CPU execution-provider partitions only; WebGPU device scheduling and Node/Chrome auxiliary threads are outside this limit

settings.dynamicShapeQualification: one untimed fresh process/runtime/session per precision and selected VolvoxAI GPU backend before per-sample execution warmup

webgpu.measuredExplicitKv: public device-buffer handoff with zero harness KV readbacks; internal provider transfers are engine-specific

parity.accuracyEvidence: single-workload exact greedy-output agreement; this is not a corpus-level accuracy metric
parity.numericTensorParity: not compared across runtimes; each runtime independently checks finite logits/caches and exact preservation of its own cache prefix

webgpu.identityScope: normalized WebGPU vendor+architecture class across isolated browser processes; no stable physical adapter identifier is exposed

cuda.reason: direct comparison requires both ONNX Runtime CUDA and native VolvoxAI CUDA samples

vulkan.reason: this harness has no ONNX Runtime Vulkan execution provider peer

opengl.reason: this harness has no ONNX Runtime OpenGL execution provider peer
